description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - The Industrial Disputes between Distilleries Company of SL PLC and Mr. K. Nawaratnerajah and two other notices
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act. This falls under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or specialized categories like land, commercial, or elections.
